findings: Legacy splitter already inserts zero crossings; independent analytic triangles agree.
Near-zero Q+ is unstable under integration order, tolerance, initial time step, and fine step controls. Do not select a passing two-point pair.
TRAP shows numerical sign-alternating ringing; Gear2 controls reduce it but do not establish strict relative Q+ convergence.
Tight tolerances cause actual timestep failures; all failure logs preserved.
Peak guard is robust for successful isolated trials; negative-control circuit fails guard. This does not upgrade strict convergence.

proposed_measurement_contract.condition: Require both max waveform difference and charge difference across refinement/method controls; keep legacy status alongside. No clipping, zero replacement, or sensor-resolution claim.
